author: Matthewyau1367

english.text: Chilton’s surprising discovery was that the bacterium inserts that piece of its DNA into the plant cell’s genes, and that DNA becomes a permanent part of the plant cell’s genetic makeup — something that had never been seen before.

jyutping: Chilton ge3 ging1 jan4 faat3 jin6 hai6，sai3 kwan2 zoeng1 keoi5 ge3 go2 dyun6 DNA caap3 jap6 zo2 zik6 mat6 sai3 baau1 ge3 gei1 jan1，ji4 ni1 dyun6 DNA zau6 sing4 wai4 zik6 mat6 sai3 baau1 gei1 jan1 zou2 sing4 maai4 ge3 wing5 gau2 bou6 fan6 —— ni1 go3 hai6 ji5 cin4 cung4 mei6 gin3 gwo3 ge3 si6。
text: Chilton 嘅驚人發現係，細菌將佢嘅嗰段 DNA 插入咗植物細胞嘅基因，而呢段 DNA 就成為植物細胞基因組成埋嘅永久部分 —— 呢個係以前從未見過嘅事。

author: Matthewyau1367

english.text: Researchers reporting in the journal The Lancet Infectious Diseases found that a lineage of the P. falciparum parasite, which causes the most dangerous form of malaria, is now becoming resistant to the most effective malaria drug, and the resistance is spreading.

jyutping: jin4 gau3 jan4 jyun4 hai2《lau5 jip6 dou1 cyun4 jim5 beng6》kei4 hon1 bou3 dou6 faat3 jin6 zo2，jan5 hei2 zeoi3 ngai4 him2 ge3 joek6 zat6 ge3 ok3 sing3 joek6 jyun4 cung4 gei3 saang1 cung4 ge3 hyut3 tung2，ji4 gaa1 deoi3 zeoi3 jau5 haau6 ge3 joek6 zat6 joek6 mat6 bin3 dak1 jau5 kong3 joek6 sing3，ji4 ce2 kong3 joek6 sing3 hai2 dou6 kwok3 saan3 gan2。
text: 研究人員喺《柳葉刀傳染病》期刊報導發現咗，引起最危險嘅瘧疾嘅惡性瘧原蟲寄生蟲嘅血統，而家對最有效嘅瘧疾藥物變得有抗藥性，而且抗藥性喺度擴散緊。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Lera Boroditsky writes that instead of employing such terms as “right,” “left,” “forward” and “back,” which are relative to an observer, many Indigenous people of Australia will exclusively use cardinal directions — north, south, east or west. To speak properly, one must stay oriented at all times. The correct response to a normal greeting — “Where are you going?” — is something like “South-southeast, in the middle distance,” but if you don’t know which way you’re facing, you can’t even get past “Hello.”

jyutping: Lera Boroditsky se2 ge3，ji4 m4 hai6 jung6「jau6」、「zo2」、「cin4 zeon3」tung4「hau6 teoi3」ni1 di1 soeng1 deoi3 jyu1 gun1 caat3 ze2 ge3 ci4 wui6，hou2 do1 ou3 zau1 jyun4 zyu6 man4 dou1 wui5 zyun1 dang1 jung6 gei1 bun2 fong1 hoeng3 —— bak1、naam4、dung1 waak6 sai1，jiu3 gong2 dak1 ngaam1，deoi3 zing3 soeng4 ge3 man6 hau6 ge3 zing3 kok3 wui4 jing3 —— 「nei5 jiu3 heoi3 bin1 dou6，daan6 hai6 nei5 jiu3 heoi3 bin1 dou6？」 nei5 m4 zi1 nei5 min6 deoi3 gan2 bin1 tiu4 lou6，nei5 lin4「haa1 lo1」dou1 gwo3 m4 dou2。
text: Lera Boroditsky 寫嘅，而唔係用「右」、「左」、「前進」同「後退」呢啲相對於觀察者嘅詞彙，好多澳洲原住民都會專登用基本方向 —— 北、南、東或西，要講得啱，對正常嘅問候嘅正確回應 —— 「你要去邊度，但係你要去邊度？」 你唔知你面對緊邊條路，你連「哈囉」都過唔到。
